title: Klippenstein Crosspost: Privacy Policy
author: Ken Klippenstein
content:
Klippenstein Crosspost is a personal publishing tool operated by Ken
Klippenstein. It runs only on his own computer and has no other users.

**What it handles.** The tool uploads videos, titles and captions that Ken
creates to accounts he owns on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Threads,
X, Bluesky, LinkedIn and Substack. To do this it stores the access tokens
those platforms issue, in a file on his computer.

**What it does not do.** It does not collect personal information about anyone
else. It does not use analytics or advertising. It does not sell, share or
transfer data to anyone except the platform a video is being posted to.

**YouTube.** The tool uses YouTube API Services. By using it you agree to the
[YouTube Terms of Service](https://www.youtube.com/t/terms). See also the
[Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy). You can revoke
the tool's access at any time from your Google Account's [security
settings](https://myaccount.google.com/permissions).

**TikTok.** You can revoke the tool's access to a TikTok account in the TikTok
app under Settings and privacy -> Security -> Apps and services permissions.

**Deletion.** Revoking access, or deleting the token file on the computer,
removes all stored data. Videos already posted stay on each platform under
that platform's own policies.

**Contact:**[kenneth.klippenstein@gmail.com](mailto:kenneth.klippenstein@gmail.com)
